benchmark_name: NEXUS-SLM Controlled Architecture Benchmark & Feasibility Evaluation

devanagari_fragmentation_inspection.text: पेमेंट करते समय गेटवे टाइमआउट हो गया और बैंक से पैसे कटने का एसएमएस आ गया।
devanagari_fragmentation_inspection.finding: Qwen2.5-0.5B completely eliminates byte-fallback tokens on native Devanagari Hindi text.

smollm_135m.access_requirements: Public un-gated Hugging Face Hub repository
known_weaknesses: Severe Devanagari byte fallback causing 0.1429 Hindi accuracy
Representational ceiling on 14 classes resulting in 0.0 recall on 4 classes
Catastrophic interference when scaled to 1,000 instances (V2 regression)
smollm_135m.safeguards_active: HumanEscalationPolicy routes 100% of Devanagari Hindi to human agents

qwen25_05b.access_requirements: Public un-gated Hugging Face Hub repository
architectural_strengths: 151,665 token vocabulary with native Devanagari subwords
Grouped Query Attention (GQA) for efficient key-value caching
SwiGLU activation and RoPE rotary position embeddings up to 32k context
hardware_constraints: Full training requires ~4.5 GB memory; local CPU-only PyTorch has 1.8 GB free RAM
bitsandbytes 4-bit quantization unavailable on Windows CPU runtime
Training must run on CUDA GPU or provisioned cloud compute (T4/A10G) to avoid CPU paging

gate_1_validation_performance.rationale: Must demonstrate statistically meaningful intent separation across all 14 categories on un-seen validation data prior to test benchmark evaluation.

gate_2_devanagari_classification.rationale: Must successfully overcome the BPE subword fragmentation defect that cripples 135M Indic classification.

gate_3_safety_recall_preservation.rationale: Zero false negative tolerance. Deterministic safeguards must remain unconditionally active and intercept 100% of safety-critical events.

gate_4_schema_conformity.rationale: Model must generate strictly valid JSON conforming to OutputParser schema without hallucinating undefined fields or formatting code blocks.

gate_5_system_resources.rationale: Model must operate within self-hosted memory envelope and satisfy production SLA of sub-2.5 second turnaround.

gate_6_service_and_dashboard_integration.requirement: Drop-in compatibility with TriageResponse Pydantic contract and Next.js /api/backend proxy

training_data_splits.locked_test: data/test/test.jsonl (N=42, SHA256: edf3fa5cd9... — Strictly preserved for final audit)

current_candidate_promotion_decision.justification: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct demonstrates decisive architectural superiority in tokenization (151k vocab, 0 byte-fallback tokens, 17.1% token reduction on Hindi) and parameter capacity (494M vs 135M). However, in accordance with Phase 3 Acceptance Gate Standards, an architecture cannot replace the active candidate merely because it is larger or produces plausible zero-shot examples. nexus-qlora-v1 remains the active candidate until a trained Qwen2.5-0.5B checkpoint empirically demonstrates Macro-F1 >= 0.55 on validation and >= 0.50 on Devanagari Hindi under reproducible evaluation.
current_candidate_promotion_decision.execution_blocker_report: The current local environment runs PyTorch CPU build (2.14.1+cpu) with 1.8 GB available RAM. Full LoRA training of 494M parameters requires ~4.5 GB active gradient/optimizer memory and ~1-2 hours CPU compute, which presents severe paging/OOM risk locally. Training must be executed with CUDA GPU acceleration (e.g. provisioned cloud compute or local GPU with CUDA PyTorch build) using the locked training script and seed=42.
